footprints.description: CTS 219 gull-wing surface-mount DIP switch, 8 positions, 2.54 mm pitch, drawn rotated 90°
footprints.note: datasheets/switch/cts/CTS-Switches-DIP-219-Series-Datasheet.pdf p.4 Figure 2 Gull Wing Surface Mount Pad Layouts (R1): pads 2.44 long x 1.13, 2.54 pitch, 6.17 between the rows, 11.04 over them -> centres 8.60 (printed); body 6.70 (+-0.25) wide x A 21.79 long for 8 positions (p.3 table). Not SW-SMD-16 (TE GDS: 2.15 x 1.52 pads, centres 8.26)

footprints.description: CIT CS1213 gull-wing SMD tactile switch, 3.9 x 2.9 mm body, 2 terminals
footprints.note: datasheets/switch/tactile/cit/Switch-CS1213.pdf p.2 CS1213AG PCB Layout (R1): two pads 1.80 high, 5.00 over them, 3.20 between them -> 0.90 wide, centres 4.10; body 3.90 x 2.90; terminal 1 left, 2 right (Schematic: 1 - switch - 2). No locating boss holes (A = without boss)

footprints.description: GCT SWT0105 J-lead SMD tactile switch, 3.7 x 3.7 mm body, 4 terminals
footprints.note: GCT drawing SWT0105 rev A sheet 1 Recommended PCB Layout (R1), datasheets/switch/tactile/gct/swt0105.pdf (https://gct.co/files/drawings/swt0105.pdf; the product specification swt0105-spec.pdf prints no drawing): solder areas 3.80 over / 2.10 between across -> 0.85 wide, centres 2.95; 3.40 over / 2.10 between down -> 0.65 high, centres 2.75; terminals 1, 2 top (left, right), 3, 4 bottom; the keep-out area between the pads is not drawn; body 3.70 x 3.70 (+-0.20)

device.note: Switching rating 20 VDC (CTS-Switches-DIP-219-Series-Datasheet.pdf p.2 Actuation Life: 100 mA @ 20 VDC; Nonswitching Rating 100 mA or 50 VDC). SPST per position (p.2 Circuit). The datasheet numbers the positions, not the terminals: position n's terminals are pins n (nA) and 17 - n (nB), as the library's other 8-position DIP switches. Ordering Information p.1: 219-8 M (medium actuator) S (bottom seal) T (top tape seal), gull wing terminals, tube.
